40019441.author: पदार्थः
40019441.content: विभीषणःVibheeshana, पुष्पभूषितम् decorated with flowers, तम् that, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, उपस्थितम् seated, कृत्वा having, अविदूरे little distance, स्थितः stood, रामम् Rama, इति this, उवाच spoke

40019441.author: Translation
40019441.content: Offering to Sri Rama the Pushpak decorated with flowers to sit, Vibheeshana stood at a distance and spoke.

40019442.author: पदार्थः
40019442.content: सःराक्षसेश्वरः he, Rakshasa king, विनीतः humbly, बद्धाञ्जलिप्रह्व: saluting with folded palms, त्वरया quickly, उपेतः approached, किम् why, करोमि to be done, इति this, राघवम् to Raghava, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019442.author: Translation
40019442.content: The Rakshasa king humbly offered salutation to Raghava with joined palms, quickly approached, and said, 'What is to be done'?

40019443.author: पदार्थः
40019443.content: महातेजाः highly brilliant, राघवः Raghava, विमृश्य thinking, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, उपशृण्वतः while listening closely, तम् him, स्नेहपुरस्कृतम् in friendly manner, इदम् this, उवाच spoke

40019443.author: Translation
40019443.content: Highly brilliant Raghava was thinking and spoke in a friendly manner while Lakshmana was listening closely.

40019444.author: पदार्थः
40019444.content: विभीषण Vibheeshana, कृतप्रयत्नकर्माणः who fought making effort, सर्वे all, वनेचराः forest rangers, रत्नैः with valuables, विविधैः several, अर्थैश्च and luxuries, सम्पूज्यन्ताम् duly honoured

40019444.author: Translation
40019444.content: "Let all the forest rangers (without exception) who made effort and fought be duly honoured with valuables and several luxuries."

40019445.author: पदार्थः
40019445.content: राक्षसेश्वर Rakshasa Lord, हृष्टैः delighted, प्राणभयम् fear of life, त्यक्त्वा giving up, सङ्ग्रामेषु in the combat, अनिवर्तिभिः who never turned back, अमीभिःसह with these heroes, त्वया by you, लङ्का Lanka, निर्जिता could win

40019445.author: Translation
40019445.content: "This Lanka could be won with the help of these heroes who never turned back and fought in comb at without fear of life, O Lord of Rakshasas."

40019446.author: पदार्थः
40019446.content: ते you, इमे these, वनौकसः forest rangers, सर्वेएव all in that way, कृतकर्माणः accomplishment, धनरत्नप्रदानेन wealth and gems, एषाम् such effort, कर्म deed, सफलम् successful, कुरु make it

40019446.author: Translation
40019446.content: "These forest rangers, all of them have struggled and accomplished success. Reward them with wealth and gems."

40019447.author: पदार्थः
40019447.content: आनदा helpless, मानार्हम् who respects, एवम् that way, कृतज्ञेन in gratitude, त्वया you, सम्मानिताः reward, एते these, हरियूथपाः monkey troops निर्वृता contended, भविष्यन्ति will be

40019447.author: Translation
40019447.content: "These helpless monkey troops will be content with gratitude when rewarded, O respectable Vibheeshana."

40019448.author: पदार्थः
40019448.content: त्यागिनम् charitable, सङ्ग्रहीतारम् not seizing, सानुक्रोशम् compassionate, जितेन्द्रियम् gained over senses, त्वाम् you, सर्वे all, अवगच्छन्ति telling you for so long, ततः then, ते you, सम्बोधयामि will call you

40019448.author: Translation
40019448.content: "If you do so you will be called as charitable and kind, not seizing wealth and as one who has gained over senses. That is why I am telling you for so long."

40019449.author: पदार्थः
40019449.content: नरेश्वरा ruler of men, सर्वैः all, रतिगुणैः devoid of virtues, हीनम् low, आहवे in battle, हन्तारम् destructor, तंनृपतिम् that king, सेना army, त्यजति will desert

40019449.author: Translation
40019449.content: "O Ruler of men, all the army will desert a king who is devoid of virtues, lowly and who is a destructor in the battlefield."

40019450.author: पदार्थः
40019450.content: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तः spoken, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सर्वानेव all, तान् वानरान् those Vanaras, रत्नार्थसम्विभागेन with gems, gold and valuables, अभ्यपूजयत् honoured them very much

40019450.author: Translation
40019450.content: Vibheeshana honoured the Vanaras with gems and valuables, after Rama had spoken like that.

40019451.author: पदार्थः
40019451.content: ततः then, रत्नार्थैः with gems, तान् हरियूथपान् those monkey troops, पूजितान् offered prayers, दृष्टवा seeing, रामः Rama, तदा then, अनुत्तमम् excellent, तत् that, विमानम् aerial car, आरुरोह ascended

40019451.author: Translation
40019451.content: Then on seeing the monkey troops being honoured with excellent gemsRama ascended the aerial car.

40019452.author: पदार्थः
40019452.content: ﻿ लज्जमानाम् who was feeling abashed, यशस्विनीम् illustrious, अङ्केन arms, आदाय taking, विक्रान्तेन valiant, धनुष्मता archer, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेनसह with Lakshmana

40019452.author: Translation
40019452.content: ﻿ Illustrious Vaidehi was abashed while she was taken in his(Hanuman’s) arms to Pushpalata while the valiant archers Lakshmana and his brother were there .

40019453.author: पदार्थः
40019453.content: सःकाकुत्स्थ: that Kakuthsa, विमानस्थः in the aerial car, सर्ववानरान् all Vanaras, सविभीषणम् and Vibheeshana, महावीर्यम् highly courageous, सुग्रीवं च Sugriva also, पूजयन् honoured, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019453.author: Translation
40019453.content: After duly honouring all the Vanaras, to Vibheeshana and highly courageous Sugriva, Kakuthsa spoke as follows.

40019454.author: पदार्थः
40019454.content: वानरर्षभाः bull among Vanaras, भवद्भिः you also, इदम् this, मित्रकार्यम् friend's work, कृतम् having done, सर्वे all, मया my, अनुज्ञाताः per mission, यथेष्टम् as you will, प्रतिगच्छत can go

40019454.author: Translation
40019454.content: "Bull among Vanaras! Since this work of the friend has been accomplished, you too have my permission to go where you will."

40019455.author: पदार्थः
40019455.content: सुग्रीव Sugriva, स्निग्धेन affectionate, हितेन च What has to be done, वयस्येन advanced in age, यत् तु all that, कार्यम् work, तत् that, सर्वम् everything, धर्मभीरुणा fear of unrighteousness, भवता by you, कृतम् done, आशु now, स्वसैन्येन with your own army, अभिसम्वृतः surrounding you, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, याहि can go

40019455.author: Translation
40019455.content: All that has to be done by an affectionate friend in advanced age has been done, for the fear of unrighteousness. Now you may advance with your army to Kishkinda.

40019456.author: पदार्थः
40019456.content: विभीषण Vibheeshana, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, मया by me, दत्ते bestowed, स्वराज्ये own kingdom, वस living, नेन्द्राः Indra, दिवौकसःअपि gods in the heaven even, त्वाम् you, धर्षयितुम् will not be able to attack, न शक्ताः not possible

40019456.author: Translation
40019456.content: "Vibheeshana, I would like to see you living like Indra bestowed with your own kingdom in Lanka. It will not be possible for even gods to attack you."

40019457.author: पदार्थः
40019457.content: ममपितुः my father's, राजधानीम् capital, अयोध्यांप्रति Lord of Ayodhya, यास्यामि to proceed for me, अभ्यनुज्ञातुम् you need to permit, इच्छामि I wish, वः be auspicious, सर्वान् all, अमंत्रयामि I take leave of

40019457.author: Translation
40019457.content: "I shall proceed to my father's capital, Ayodhya. You may permit me. Be auspicious. I take leave of you."

40019458.author: पदार्थः
40019458.content: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्ताः spoken, हरीन्द्राः Sugriva, तथा that way, हरयः monkeys, राक्षसः Rakshasas, विभीषणश्च Vibheeshana's, सर्वे all, प्राञ्जलयः saluting, ऊचुः said

40019458.author: Translation
40019458.content: After Rama had spoken that way Sugriva, Vibheeshana, monkeys and Rakshasas saluted Rama and said as follows.

40019459.author: पदार्थः
40019459.content: अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, गन्तुम् proceed, इच्छामः wish, भवान् we, सर्वान् all, नः nay, नयतु to go, मुद्युक्ताः with you, वनानि forests, उपवनानि च groves, विचरिष्यामः will range without anxiety

40019459.author: Translation
40019459.content: We wish to proceed with you to Ayodhya, and many wishes to go with you and range the forests and groves without anxiety.

40019460.author: पदार्थः
40019460.content: नृपसत्तम jewel among kings, अभिषेकार्द्रम् getting consecrated, त्वाम् you, दृष्टवा seeing, कौसल्याम् Kausalya, अभिवाद्य च greeting, अचिरात् soon, स्वगृहान् own house, अगमिष्यामः will return

40019460.author: Translation
40019460.content: "O Jewel among kings! We will see you being consecrated and see Kausalya, greet her and return back to our own house."

40019461.author: पदार्थः
40019461.content: सविभीषणैः Vibheeshana, वानरैः Vanaras, एवम् in that way, उक्तः spoken, धर्मात्मा righteous, सःरामः he, Rama, ससुग्रीवविभीषणान् Sugriva and Vibheeshana, वानरान् Vanaras, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019461.author: Translation
40019461.content: Vibheeshana and Vanaras had spoken in that way, Rama replied to Sugriva, Vibheeshana and Vanaras as follows.

40019462.author: पदार्थः
40019462.content: अहम् I, ससुहृज्जनः with my dear and near, सर्वैः all, भवद्भिः you also, सहितः together, पुरीम् Ayodhya, गतः go, प्रीतिम् happy, यत् that, लप्स्ये gain, प्रियात् dear Sita, प्रियतरम् very happy, लब्दम् give

40019462.author: Translation
40019462.content: "If I with my dear and near and together with you go to Ayodhya, that will give more happiness with Sita coming and with all of you."

40019463.author: पदार्थः
40019463.content: सुग्रीव Sugriva, वानरैःसह with Vanaras, क्षिप्रम् quickly, विमानम् aerial car, आरोह ascended, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, विभीषण Vibheeshana, सामात्यः ministers, त्वमपि all, आरोह ascended

40019463.author: Translation
40019463.content: Sugriva and the Vanaras, quickly ascended the aerial car. Vibheeshana, the king of Rakshasas and ministers all of them ascended.

40019464.author: पदार्थः
40019464.content: ततः then, सःसुग्रीवः Sugriva, वानरैःसह with Vanaras, मुदा happy, युक्तः joined, दिव्यम् wonderful, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, आरुरोह ascended, सामात्यः ministers, विभीषणश्च Vibheeshana

40019464.author: Translation
40019464.content: Then Sugriva with Vanaras happily joined the wonderful Pushpaka, Vibheeshana and his ministers also ascended.

40019465.author: पदार्थः
40019465.content: तेषु those, सर्वेषु all, आरूढेषु having got in, कौबेरम् Kubera's, परमासनम् supreme seat, राघवेण by Raghava, अभ्यनुज्ञातम् with his permission, विहायसम् sky, उत्पपात flew

40019465.author: Translation
40019465.content: All the Vanaras and others having got into Kubera's Pushpaka with Rama's permission, it flew into the sky.

40019466.author: पदार्थः
40019466.content: प्रहृष्टश्च delighted, प्रतीतश्च thrilled, रामः Rama, खगतेन in the sky, हंसयुक्तेन with pictures of swans, भास्वता shining, विमानेन by the aerial car, कुबेरवत् like Kubera, बभौ shone

40019466.author: Translation
40019466.content: Delighted and thrilled, Rama was flying in the sky in Pushpaka and with shining swans, he shone like Kubera.
